lines: Three plates. Three stones.
Somewhere overhead a counterweight lets go, and the gate grinds up out of the floor.
A cut-stone figure, arms folded, standing where the stairs ought to be.
There is a slot in the floor where a counterweight chain would run.
The chain is there. It is slack.
Gate's up. She'll be expecting you.
She's always expecting people. Nineteen years underground does that, apparently.
Three stones, three plates in the floor. One each. That's the whole of it.
You can't pull them, only push. So think about which side you want to be on.
And if you wedge one somewhere stupid, walk out and walk back in.
They go home. Everything in here goes home eventually. That's the joke.
Still here? North road's shut and it'll stay shut, whatever Ashgate tells you.
Go east when you can. Brackwater wants people who can take a hit.
You received the QUARRY SEAL.
The first of eight.
Nineteen years on the west face taught me exactly one thing worth passing on.
Anything moves. Most of it just wants a shoulder and a reason.
You learned the field art SHOULDER.
Heavy stones out in the world can be pushed now.
Roxen handed over a Great Potion.
One more thing, {name}, and I'd like you to actually hear this one.
The Concord surveyed my quarry in the spring. Depth soundings, they called it.
They weren't measuring the rock. They were measuring what the rock sits on.
Ask them about it sometime. Watch how fast they stop being friendly.
